notes:
Real card (forge-model/data/osteomancer-adept.txt): Osteomancer Adept, {1}{B}, Creature — Squirrel Warlock, 2/2, K:Deathtouch, and A:AB$ Effect | Cost$ T | StaticAbilities$ MayCast | Triggers$ StaticCast | SpellDescription$ 'Until end of turn, you may cast creature spells from your graveyard by foraging in addition to paying their other costs. If you cast a spell this way, that creature enters with a finality counter on it.' Mana cost, type line, P/T, and node C's unconditional Deathtouch (matching K:Deathtouch) all reconstruct correctly — nodes A/B/C are faithful.

The bug is isolated to node D. D correctly captures only the {T} activation cost (role:tap, bf→bf, thing:self, matching Cost$ T), but it is a bare root with an empty flow.steps entry and nothing else in the packet references it — so the entire effect this cost pays for is missing from the decomposition, and the reconstructing agent correctly reported it as undeterminable rather than inventing something. In the real Forge script, Cost$ T pays for an AB$ Effect that itself bundles two sub-abilities via StaticAbilities$/Triggers$, none of which have any corresponding node:
1. SVar:MayCast (Mode$ Continuous | Affected$ Creature.nonLand+YouOwn | MayPlay$ True | AffectedZone$ Graveyard | RaiseCost$ Forage) — the actual granted permission: 'you may cast creature spells from your graveyard, paying forage as an additional cost,' until end of turn. No modifier node grants this anywhere in the packet.
2. SVar:StaticCast (Mode$ SpellCast | ValidCard$ Card.CastSa Spell.MayPlaySource | Static$ True) — a static trigger scoped specifically to a spell cast via this ability's own MayPlaySource grant ('if you cast a spell this way'). No trigger node with this scoping exists.
3. SVar:TrigEffect → SVar:ReMoved → SVar:ETBCounter — a replacement effect intercepting the remembered/triggered card's Stack→Battlefield move (Event$ Moved | Origin$ Stack | Destination$ Battlefield) and replacing it with an ETB PutCounter (CounterType$ FINALITY | CounterNum$ 1), i.e. 'that creature enters with a finality counter on it.' No becomes/modifier node encodes this either. (SVar:RemoveSelf is pure engine cleanup of the temporary Effect object, Command→Exile, with no printed-text footprint, so its absence is correctly not a gap.)

This reads as a decomposition/translator gap in forgeTranslate.ts: it emitted the tap-cost node (D) but did not walk past it into the nested AB$ Effect's StaticAbilities$/Triggers$ sub-abilities, so nothing downstream of the top-level `A:` line's own Cost$ was ever translated into edges. Separately, even once that chain is walked, the registries as given have no established idiom to express two of its pieces cleanly: (a) 'forage' as a cost/raise-cost (the actions registry has surveil-N/mill-N/loot/scry-N/job-select but no forage entry, despite forage being a two-branch disjunctive cost — exile 3 cards from graveyard OR sacrifice a Food — that's a natural combine:"any" candidate the same way surveil-N models exile-with-a-cap), and (b) granting a numbered counter type (here FINALITY) on an entering permanent, which isn't called out anywhere in the flags vocabulary handed to the reconstructing agent (only a P/T-delta example, `cond:equipped;delta=+1/+1`, is shown) — worth checking whether SCHEMA.md's fuller text (outside this packet) already covers counters, or whether this is a genuine open question for §8. Packet reading was clean — the agent used the self registry, full schema, and all four nodes (A/B/C/D) and flagged exactly D's missing effect rather than fabricating one; this is not a process error or agent misinterpretation.
